method: Fixed-budget randomized/evolutionary black-box optimization, separate weights per auction type; no neural-network/LLM training
objective: Mean pairwise finish score + 0.002 * game score, equally weighted across three synthetic opponent families
selection: Top four non-baseline refined candidates plus frozen baseline enter validation. Highest validation objective wins separately by auction; ties favor baseline. Freeze weights and hashes before any final test game. No retraining or promotion chosen from final outcomes.
statistics: Paired bootstrap over independent deal means. Six seats and all settings using a deal are clustered together for aggregate comparisons. 5000 resamples; per-comparison intervals, no multiple-comparison correction.
limitations: All opponents are synthetic. Populations have distinct parameter draws across splits but share policy implementations.
The fixed historical frontier comparator deliberately shares frozen opponents with the prior experiment; it is separate from the disjoint generated populations.
Only 48 independent final deals. More seats and settings do not make new independent deals.
Synthetic missed windows are not measured live network latency.
